crossRefs.note: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
You shall flee by the valley of my mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel; yes, you shall flee…
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person…
The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!
Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
translations.bsb: At their cries, all the people of Israel who were around them fled, saying, “The earth may swallow us too!”
translations.kjv: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up
translations.asv: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them; for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up.
